the compensation for infringement of the personal right shall be the compensation for the damage caused by the infringement of the right, which includes the compensation for mental damage, and that compensation for infringement of personality right shall be granted only when the damage caused is serious and the infringer is at fault, and that the compensation for the infringement of personality right is limited by the amount of the damage caused.
the compensation for infringement of the personal right shall be granted only if there is an infringement of the right and if there is a loss caused by the infringement.
compensation for infringement of a personal right is a special kind of compensation for damage.

compensation for infringement of the personal right is an essential component of compensation law, which should be included in the civil law.

the object and the extent of compensation for infringement should be limited to the actual damage caused to the personal rights of the injured party; and the requisites for compensation are: 1) the infringement of personal rights should be a real one; 2) it should cause actual damage to the personal rights, and 3) it should be the direct cause of the damage.
